question: In which of the following years did Rabindranath Tagore establish an experimental school at Santiniketan?
solution:
Correct answer is** **__**1901**__.

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• On** 22nd December 1901**, Rabindranath Tagore started his school at **Santiniketan** with five students (including his eldest son) and the same number of teachers.
 
• He initially named it** Brahmacharya Ashram **in the tradition of old forest hermitages.
 
• **Rabindranath Tagore** wrote numerous of his literary classics at Santiniketan. 
 
• He viewed his school as an house of peace where living in harmony with nature, children would cultivate their **natural creativity.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Rabindranath Tagore** (1861 – 1941) is popular as a poet, and in **1913** was the first non-European author to be awarded the **Nobel Prize for Literature.**
 
• Globally, **Gitanjali is Tagore's best-known collection of poetry,** for which he was awarded the Nobel Prize in 1913.
